NOAA states the energy form explicitly for the analogous VIIRS RSRs (ATBD 474-00027 Eq. 9) and GOES-R ABI SRFs (doi:10.1117/12.2238090 Eq. 1-2), but no JMA document found says it for AHI, so NJM's energy stays assumed.
